div.div: مَنْهُوسٌ A man having little flesh; (S, A, K;) [as though it were partly eaten off the bones;] as also ↓ نَهِيسٌ . (TA.) You say also, مَنْهُوسُ القَدَمَيْنِ, (A, K,) or الكَعْبَيْنِ, (TA,) A man (TA) having little flesh upon the feet, (A, * K, * TA,) or upon the ankles. (TA.) And وَظيفٌ ↓ نَهِيسٌ [A shank of a quadruped] light of flesh. (TA.) See also مَنْهُوشٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
